source_text: Neonatal or childhood circumcision reduces the risk of invasive penile cancer, with a meta-analysis of case-control studies showing an odds ratio of 0.33 (95% CI 0.13–0.83) for men circumcised before adulthood versus uncircumcised men. [4]
